in_sanskrit.name: बल्वान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: बल- (bal-) meaning 'strength' or 'power' + वान् (vān-) meaning 'carrier' or 'vehicle'. So, Balvan can be translated to 'He who carries great strength' or 'He who is a powerful carrier'.
